purpose: Local document/GIS/3D comparison; not economic or legal certification
local_data: existing comparison, ownership, CAD and model data packages
external_runtime: ČÚZK public orthophoto, transparent cadastre and terrain services
offline: Leaflet and data are local; original PDF previews available; 3D falls back to local orthographic massing with flat terrain if SDK/services cannot load.
storage: localStorage document/image relevance; sessionStorage draft fee allocation and phase selection; no server writes
fonts: Fellix/Segoe UI font stacks, installed-font fallbacks; no bundled font download introduced
controls: Default single 3D scene with multiple proposals and independent 0–100% opacity
Second mode: up to three synchronized comparison scenes
Rotation enabled by default; lock and fit icons inside every scene
Mobile comparison scenes stacked vertically; lock to scroll over scene
Shared separate subview buttons and collapsible filters
Common checkbox table filters and typed sorting; excludes source transcriptions
Sequential full-phase timeline; three boundaries divide each fixed phase budget into four shares totaling 100%; selected-phase weighted totals

startup_fallback.scope: Inline styled explanation when sibling assets or JavaScript are unavailable; does not make the dashboard a standalone mobile attachment

offer_ui_storage: sessionStorage urbiq-mh-fee-allocation-v2; cumulative integer CZK boundaries, selection and subtab; migrates and normalizes v1 allocations

overview_ui.scope: Viewport overview and default entry view only; live counts from existing catalogs; no new network calls or persistence

chapter_ui.storage: sessionStorage urbiq-mh-timeline-split; ratio only; no uploads

zone_balances.network: No additional requests; local metric results. Existing live map providers unchanged.

drawer_ui.description: Persistent right white rail with chart toggle at top, no close button; desktop map reserves rail width.

scene_balances.data: Read-only SceneBalanceData API from existing dashboard-scene.js model parts
scene_balances.network: No new services. Optional ArcGIS runtime failure falls back to existing local model.

offer_compact.storage: sessionStorage urbiq-mh-fee-allocation-v3; new screenshot defaults replace financial initialization once; prior v2 data retained, selection/tab/extension carried over.
offer_compact.schedule: Optional first-phase extension by one month, no gap; original milestones remain in source notes. Existing delayMonths storage field reused.

offer_budget_step.migration: Round v3 working shares, preserve selection/delay and original storage

responsive_lv_ui.behavior: Header stays visible, allocation rows use spare height, ownership tree groups source/candidate LV. Selected map balances independent of opacity.
responsive_lv_ui.storage: No new storage; expanded LV IDs kept in memory

ownership_zone_view.storage: sessionStorage urbiq-mh-ownership-zones-v1; selected working zone IDs only
ownership_zone_view.network: No new background requests; explicit parcel links to official Nahlížení do KN
ownership_zone_view.legal_verification: No new in-scope LV verified. State/LV2460 identity is user-provided.

entry_polish.storage: Existing allocation storage unchanged; no new persistence
entry_polish.network: No new runtime services; external providers remain optional map/3D dependencies
entry_polish.boot: Neutral loading; attachment guidance only for multi-file builds with failed initialization or disabled JavaScript
